Every method of `PlatformAuth`, grouped by resource. Types are under the `PlatformAuth` namespace (`import type { PlatformAuth } from "@productcraft/platform-auth"`). Every method takes per-request options last (`{ idempotencyKey, timeout, maxRetries, headers, signal, workspaceId }`).

## account

### `platform.account.erase(options?)`

`DELETE /v1/account` → `void`

Delete the calling account. Auto-promotes the oldest admin (or oldest non-self member) to owner in any workspace where the departing account is the sole owner. Linked provider grants that require server-side revocation (Sign in with Apple) are revoked with the provider.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The session lacks the required action for self-account deletion (defence-in-depth — the route is guarded but the cookie may be present without action access). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No account row exists for the session principal. Should never fire for a valid session — surfaced for SDKs. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.account.erase();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#delete-v1-account)

## apiKeys

### `platform.apiKeys.self(options?)`

`GET /v1/api-keys/self` → `PlatformAuth.ApiKeySelf`

Describe the workspace key making this request: its name, workspace, expiry and what it may do in plain sentences. Call it with `Authorization: Bearer pcft_live_…` to test a key right after minting it.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No bearer, or the key is unknown, revoked or expired. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED` | Signed in with a session or another token instead of a workspace key (`WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED`). Send the `pcft_live_…` key as the bearer. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `PAK_NOT_FOUND` | The key was deleted while the request was in flight (`PAK_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const apiKeySelf = await platform.apiKeys.self();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-api-keys-self)

### `platform.auth.signin(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/auth/signin` → `PlatformAuth.Token`

Sign in with email/username and password.

Every failed attempt answers `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, whatever went wrong: unknown identifier, wrong password, an account with no password credential, an account locked out through a different identifier, an account an operator has blocked, and a wrong password against a suspended or deactivated account. The responses are deliberately identical in body and timing, so sign-in never reveals whether an account exists.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.AuthSigninParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failed |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | Invalid credentials (`INVALID_CREDENTIALS`). Returned for every failed attempt, including a correct password offered while the account is locked out or blocked, and a wrong password against a suspended or deactivated account. The body never says which. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`, `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED` | The account is suspended (`ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`) or deactivated (`ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED`). Only reachable once the caller has proven the password — a wrong password against such an account is a 401. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED`, `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS` | Too many attempts for this identifier (`TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`). Two counters produce it, both keyed purely by the submitted identifier: a burst limit of 5 attempts per minute, and a 15-minute lock after 4 failed attempts. Both fire on the same attempt for a registered and an unregistered identifier. Per-IP limit: rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const token = await platform.auth.signin({ identifier: "user@example.com", password: "MySecurePassword123" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-auth-signin)

## auth.password

### `platform.auth.password.requestReset(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/auth/password/request-reset` → `void`

Request a password reset email. Neither the response nor its timing reveals whether the email matched an account.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.AuthPasswordRequestResetParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Body failed validation (`email` missing or not an email address). Depends only on the request shape, never on whether an account exists. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: more than 10 requests/min from this IP (strict `auth` bucket). `Retry-After` header set. Per-IP limit: rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.auth.password.requestReset({ email: "user@example.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-auth-password-request-reset)

### `platform.auth.password.reset(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/auth/password/reset` → `void`

Reset password using the email-delivered reset token.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.AuthPasswordResetParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID` | Body failed validation, the new password fails the password policy, or the reset token is invalid or expired (`PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: more than 10 requests/min from this IP (strict `auth` bucket). `Retry-After` header set. Per-IP limit: rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts

```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-auth-password-reset)

## introspect

### `platform.introspect.apiKey(options?)`

`POST /v1/introspect/api-key` → `PlatformAuth.IntrospectApiKey`

Resolve a Platform API Key (PAK) to its workspace + IAM-style policy. Call it with the key a request to your backend carried, cache the answer for up to 60 seconds, and allow an action only when the returned `policy` allows it on the resource.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or malformed `Authorization: Bearer` header, or the PAK is unknown, revoked or expired. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const introspectApiKey = await platform.introspect.apiKey();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-introspect-api-key)

### `platform.introspect.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/introspect` → `PlatformAuth.Introspect`

Introspect current user with workspace list.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: more than 60 requests/min from this IP (default bucket). Anonymous callers, and callers whose session has been signed out, otherwise get 200 with `is_authenticated: false`, never 401. Per-IP limit: rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const introspect = await platform.introspect.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-introspect)

### `platform.me.avatar.upload(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/me/avatar` → `PlatformAuth.AvatarUrl`

Upload (or replace) the caller's avatar. PNG/JPEG/WEBP only — SVG is rejected because user-uploaded SVG from a productcraft.co origin is a stored-XSS vector. ≤2 MB. Magic bytes are sniffed; a mislabeled file is rejected.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.MeAvatarUploadParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid file: wrong mimetype, oversized, or content does not match the declared type. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No session. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const avatarUrl = await platform.me.avatar.upload({ file: new File(["…"], "image.png", { type: "image/png" }) });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-me-avatar)

## me.hiddenGuides

### `platform.me.hiddenGuides.hide(key, options?)`

`PUT /v1/me/hidden-guides/{key}` → `PlatformAuth.HiddenGuide`

Hide a getting-started guide for the caller.

Idempotent: hiding a guide that is already hidden returns it unchanged, with its first `hidden_at`. At most 200 are kept; hiding one more drops the oldest.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | The key is not a valid guide key. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No session. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | The caller authenticated with a non-human principal (e.g. a workspace API key). Hidden guides are a person's console preference. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const hiddenGuide = await platform.me.hiddenGuides.hide("dashboard");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#put-v1-me-hidden-guides-key)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts

```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-me-hidden-guides)

## me.profile

### `platform.me.profile.update(params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/me/profile` → `PlatformAuth.MeProfile`

Update the caller's profile. Currently only `displayName` is editable. An empty body is a no-op that returns the current profile. Cookie/JWT only — this is a human-self-service surface, not a PAK-mutation surface.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.MeProfileUpdateParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failed (e.g. displayName outside 1-128 chars). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No session. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | The caller authenticated with a non-human principal (e.g. PAK). Profile is per-human; only the human owner can mutate their own row. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const meProfile = await platform.me.profile.update({ display_name: "Ada Lovelace" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#patch-v1-me-profile)

## oauth.connections

### `platform.oauth.connections.delete(grantId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/oauth/connections/{grant_id}` → `void`

Disconnect a client.

Revokes the whole grant family — the grant, its authorization codes, its refresh tokens and every live access token — in one transaction.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such connection for this human. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.oauth.connections.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#delete-v1-oauth-connections-grant-id)

### `platform.oauth.connections.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/oauth/connections` → `PagePromise<PlatformAuth.ConnectedClient>`

List clients this human has connected.

The user-facing half of revocation: which third-party clients hold a grant, in which workspace, carrying which policy.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.OauthConnectionListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed `cursor`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const connection of platform.oauth.connections.list()) {
  console.log(connection);
}
const page = await platform.oauth.connections.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-oauth-connections)

## oauth.workspaces.connections

### `platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.delete(workspaceId, grantId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/oauth/workspaces/{workspace_id}/connections/{grant_id}` → `void`

Disconnect a client on behalf of the workspace.

Revokes the whole grant family for a grant made by any member of this workspace — the lever a workspace owner needs when an employee leaves and their MCP client is still running. Requires `workspace.connection.revoke`.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Not a member, or lacks `workspace.connection.revoke`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such connection in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#delete-v1-oauth-workspaces-workspace-id-connections-grant-id)

### `platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.list(workspaceId, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/oauth/workspaces/{workspace_id}/connections` → `PagePromise<PlatformAuth.ConnectedClient>`

List every client connected to a workspace.

The workspace-side half of revocation, for owners and admins: every grant made against this workspace, by any member, including grants made by people who have since left. Requires `workspace.connection.read`.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.OauthWorkspaceConnectionListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed `cursor`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Not a member, or lacks `workspace.connection.read`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const connection of platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.list("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f")) {
  console.log(connection);
}
const page = await platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.list("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-oauth-workspaces-workspace-id-connections)

### `platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.restore(workspaceId, grantId, options?)`

`POST /v1/oauth/workspaces/{workspace_id}/connections/{grant_id}/restore` → `void`

Lift a workspace revocation so the member may reconnect.

A workspace revocation is durable: the member re-running the connect flow does not undo it, so an administrator has to. This clears the block only — every token minted under the old grant stays revoked and the member still has to approve a fresh consent screen. Requires `workspace.connection.revoke`.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing or invalid session, or a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Not a member, or lacks `workspace.connection.revoke`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such connection in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | The connection was not revoked by an administrator — there is nothing to lift. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.oauth.workspaces.connections.restore("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-oauth-workspaces-workspace-id-connections-grant-id-restore)

### `platform.sessions.delete(id, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/session/{id}` → `PlatformAuth.RevokeSession`

Revoke one of the caller's own sessions. Takes effect immediately — the refresh token stops working straight away, not at the end of its window.

### `platform.sessions.revokeOthers(options?)`

`POST /v1/session/revoke-others` → `PlatformAuth.RevokeOtherSessions`

Sign out every other session of the caller, keeping the one this request was made with. Takes effect immediately for the revoked sessions. Idempotent: a repeat call revokes 0.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Unauthorized |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | The access token maps to no session (minted before sessions tracked token ids), so the current session cannot be kept. Sign in again. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts

```

## stats

### `platform.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceStats`

Workspace stats.

Member count, active platform API keys, admin changes in the window with a daily series, the last admin change and the last API-key use, for the console dashboard.

Admin changes are workspace audit events that record a mutation. Reads (any action ending `.read`), sign-ins (`auth.signin.succeeded`) and MCP tool-call rows (`workspace.mcp_tool.*`) are not counted, so opening the console does not move the numbers. Days are UTC. Counts and timestamps only: no actor identifiers. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `PlatformAuth.StatsRetrieveParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d, or `workspaceId` is the slug of a workspace the caller can read rather than its UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_A_MEMBER` | Caller is not a member of the workspace (`NOT_A_MEMBER`) or lacks `workspace.audit.read` on it. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: no workspace has this id (or slug). Same answer as the service's other workspace routes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const workspaceStats = await platform.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

## workspaces.apiKeys

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.create(workspaceSlug, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys` → `PlatformAuth.MintPak`

Mint a new PAK. Choose what it can do with `preset` (a ready-made set such as `mail-send`) or `policy_ids` (managed policies you wrote), never both. The plaintext `token` is returned ONCE — store it now, then call `GET /v1/api-keys/self` with it to check what it can do. The minter can grant at most their own effective permissions. Cookie/JWT only — PAKs cannot mint other PAKs. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe: a retry of a mint that succeeded mints nothing and answers `409 PAK_ALREADY_MINTED` with that key's `id` (the token itself is never cached).

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PAK_NAME_REQUIRED`, `PAK_NAME_TOO_LONG` | Body failed validation (`VALIDATION_ERROR`): neither or both of `policy_ids` and `preset`, an unknown `preset`, an empty `policy_ids`, more than 25 policies, or a blank/overlong `name` (`PAK_NAME_REQUIRED` / `PAK_NAME_TOO_LONG`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing, malformed or invalid session. Also a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_A_MEMBER`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller is a PAK (`pcft_live_*`) — mint requires a human-issued session; or is not a member (`NOT_A_MEMBER`), lacks `workspace.apikey.create`, or cannot grant one or more actions in the chosen preset or policies. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `POLICY_NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found, or one of `policy_ids` does not exist in this workspace (`POLICY_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `PAK_ALREADY_MINTED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `PAK_ALREADY_MINTED`: this `Idempotency-Key` already minted a key (its `id` is in `details`); the token was shown once, so rotate that key for a new one. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const mintPak = await platform.workspaces.apiKeys.create("acme", { name: "Production mail", preset: "mail-send" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-api-keys)

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.delete(workspaceSlug, id, params?, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys/{id}` → `void`

Revoke a PAK. Default behaviour: introspect returns null on the next upstream call; downstream services fail-closed within the 60s cache TTL window. Pass `?force=true` to additionally publish a Redis fan-out that evicts the matching cache entry across every PAK-consuming service immediately — use it when rotating a leaked PAK and the 60s window matters.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyDeleteParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing, malformed or invalid session, or a PAK bearer (this route accepts cookie/JWT sessions only). Also a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_A_MEMBER`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller is not a member of this workspace (`NOT_A_MEMBER`), or lacks `workspace.apikey.delete`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `PAK_NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found, or PAK not found in this workspace (`PAK_NOT_FOUND`). Revoking an already-revoked PAK is a 204 no-op. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await platform.workspaces.apiKeys.delete("acme", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#delete-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-api-keys-id)

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.list(workspaceSlug, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys` → `PagePromise<PlatformAuth.PublicApiKey>`

List the API keys in this workspace.

Newest first, as the standard cursor-paginated `{data, pagination}` envelope (20 per page, at most 100). Plaintext tokens are never returned, only prefixes and metadata.

**Deprecated legacy shape:** a request that sends neither `limit` nor `cursor` gets a bare JSON array of every key (capped at 1000), unless its `User-Agent` is a ProductCraft SDK (`productcraft-…`), which always gets the envelope. The array is kept only for `@productcraft/platform-auth` 0.0.x clients and is removed in the platform API's next major version; send `limit` (or use an SDK).

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed `cursor`, or `include_revoked` is not `true` or `false` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const apiKey of platform.workspaces.apiKeys.list("acme")) {
  console.log(apiKey);
}
const page = await platform.workspaces.apiKeys.list("acme", {}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-api-keys)

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.preview(workspaceSlug, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys/preview` → `PlatformAuth.PakGrantPreview`

Describe the key a mint with this `preset` or these `policy_ids` would create, without creating anything: what it could do in plain sentences, and whether you may mint it. Read-only, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`. Powers the review step of the console key wizard.

A key you could not mint is NOT a 403 here: it comes back with `grantable: false`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.rotate(workspaceSlug, id, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys/{id}/rotate` → `PlatformAuth.RotatePak`

Mint a replacement for an existing PAK, carrying its name, description and policy bindings over. The outgoing key keeps working for `grace_hours` (24 by default) so a fleet can roll over without downtime. The plaintext `token` is returned ONCE. Cookie/JWT only — a PAK cannot rotate a PAK, for the same reason it cannot mint one.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyRotateParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing or invalid session, or a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller is a PAK (`pcft_live_*`), or cannot grant one or more actions in the bindings being carried across. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | PAK not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `PAK_REVOKED`, `PAK_EXPIRED` | The key is revoked (`PAK_REVOKED`), already expired (`PAK_EXPIRED`), or has no policy bindings to carry across. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.update(workspaceSlug, id, params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys/{id}` → `PlatformAuth.PublicApiKey`

Update a PAK’s name or description (does not touch bindings).

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyUpdateParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PAK_NAME_REQUIRED` | `id` is not a UUID, body failed validation, or `name` is blank (`PAK_NAME_REQUIRED`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing, malformed or invalid session, or a PAK bearer (this route accepts cookie/JWT sessions only). Also a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_A_MEMBER`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller is not a member of this workspace (`NOT_A_MEMBER`), or lacks `workspace.apikey.update`. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `PAK_NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found, or PAK not found in this workspace (`PAK_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `PAK_REVOKED` | PAK is revoked (`PAK_REVOKED`). |

```ts
const publicApiKey = await platform.workspaces.apiKeys.update("acme", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { description: "Sends receipts from the checkout service." });
```

### `platform.workspaces.apiKeys.updateBindings(workspaceSlug, id, params, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/api-keys/{id}/bindings` → `PlatformAuth.PublicApiKey`

Replace the managed-policy bindings on a PAK. Re-runs caller-narrowing on the merged union of statements.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceApiKeyUpdateBindingsParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One of: bound > 25 policies; merged > 200 statements; one of the policy ids does not exist or lives in a different workspace. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing or invalid session, or a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller cannot grant one or more actions in the merged statement set. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | PAK not found in this workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | Empty bindings — revoke the PAK instead of leaving it unbound. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const publicApiKey = await platform.workspaces.apiKeys.updateBindings("acme", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { policy_ids: ["11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"] });
```

## workspaces.auditFeed

### `platform.workspaces.auditFeed.list(workspaceSlug, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/audit-feed` → `PagePromise<PlatformAuth.FeedItem>`

Unified workspace audit feed (cursor-paginated).

Audit timeline for workspace-scoped events — workspace, member, role, invite, service-activation, PAK and OAuth-consent mutations, plus successful sign-ins and completed password resets. Per-app Auth rows are NOT merged in: they live in another database with no cursor that spans both, and they are served by `GET /v1/apps/:appId/audit-logs` (paginated), `.../audit-logs/export` (streamed) and the per-app audit sink. The `sources` field reports that explicitly rather than implying a pending follow-up.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceAuditFeedListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid query params — `actor_id` is not a well-formed UUID, or `cursor` is not a cursor this endpoint minted. `since`/`until` that do not parse as ISO-8601 are ignored rather than rejected, and `sources` silently drops unknown names; an empty result set after those filters still returns 200. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is signed in but lacks `workspace.audit.read` for this workspace. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:workspaceSlug` path param does not resolve to a workspace the caller can see. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const auditFeed of platform.workspaces.auditFeed.list("acme")) {
  console.log(auditFeed);
}
const page = await platform.workspaces.auditFeed.list("acme", {}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-audit-feed)

## workspaces.auditLogs

### `platform.workspaces.auditLogs.export(workspaceSlug, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/audit-logs/export` → `Response`

Stream the workspace audit log as NDJSON or CSV, applying the same `?action=` / `?actor_id=` / `?since=` / `?until=` filters as the list. Newest first. Reading the export is itself audited.

The response is streamed: rows are walked in keyset batches and written as they are read, so neither the service nor the client holds the whole log. This is the SOC 2 / GDPR export the platform docs promise. Hard cap of 1,000,000 rows per call; a wider request is refused with 413 before any body is written, so a truncated file can never masquerade as a complete one.

- Params: `PlatformAuth.WorkspaceAuditLogExportParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown `format`, or malformed `since` / `until`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `workspace.audit.read`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found. |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | More than 1,000,000 rows match. Narrow the window with `since` / `until` and retry. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await platform.workspaces.auditLogs.export("acme");
const text = await response.text();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-audit-logs-export)

List workspace audit log entries, newest first. Filter by `?action=`, `?actor_id=`, and/or the `?since=` / `?until=` date range. 20/page (max 100), cursor-paginated.

```ts

  console.log(auditLog);
```

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing or invalid session, or a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_A_MEMBER`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller is not a member (`NOT_A_MEMBER`), lacks `workspace.policy.create` (owner and admin hold it by default), or the policy grants an action the caller does not hold. A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Name already in use, or the workspace already has 100 policies. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const managedPolicy = await platform.workspaces.policies.create("acme", {
  name: "mail-readonly",
  policy: [{ actions: ["mail.read", "mail.list"], effect: "allow", resources: ["*"] }],
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/platform/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-slug-policies)

### `platform.workspaces.policies.delete(workspaceSlug, policyId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_slug}/policies/{policy_id}` → `PlatformAuth.ManagedPolicyDeleted`

Delete a managed policy. Cascades: API keys lose the binding (deny-all if no other bindings remain); roles fall back to their inline policy column. Owners and admins; a policy bound to a role, or a preset policy, only an owner can delete. Cookie/JWT only.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `SESSION_REVOKED` | Missing or invalid session, or a session that has been signed out (`SESSION_REVOKED`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `OWNER_ROLE_REQUIRED`, `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | Caller lacks `workspace.policy.delete`, or is not an owner and the policy is bound to a role or is a preset policy (`OWNER_ROLE_REQUIRED`). A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`) is refused with `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED`: this route needs a person's session. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `POLICY_NOT_FOUND` | Policy not found in this workspace (`POLICY_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const managedPolicyDeleted = await platform.workspaces.policies.delete("acme", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED` | Account deactivated. |
| `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` | Account suspended. |
| `ALREADY_A_MEMBER` | Already a member. |
| `CROSS_ORIGIN_REJECTED` | The request came from an origin that is not allowed for this cookie-authenticated route. |
| `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` | Verify the account email first. |
| `INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH` | The invite was sent to a different email address. |
| `INVITE_EXHAUSTED` | Invite exhausted. |
| `INVITE_EXPIRED` | Invite expired. |
| `INVITE_INVALID` | Invite invalid. |
| `INVITE_NOT_FOUND` | Invite not found. |
| `INVITE_REVOKED` | Invite revoked. |
| `LAST_MEMBER` | The workspace's last member cannot leave; delete the workspace instead. |
| `MEMBER_RANK_EXCEEDED` | You cannot manage a member whose role ranks above yours. |
| `NOT_A_MEMBER` | The caller is not a member of this workspace. |
| `OAUTH_GRANT_ADMIN_REVOKED` | An admin revoked this OAuth grant. |
| `OWNER_ROLE_REQUIRED` | Only an owner can do this. |
| `PAK_ALREADY_MINTED` | This Idempotency-Key already minted an API key; its token is shown once. Rotate that key (its `id` is in `details`) for a new token. |
| `PAK_EXPIRED` | Pak expired. |
| `PAK_NAME_REQUIRED` | An API key needs a name. |
| `PAK_NAME_TOO_LONG` | The API key name is too long. |
| `PAK_NOT_FOUND` | Pak not found. |
| `PAK_REVOKED` | Pak revoked. |
| `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID` | The password reset code is invalid or expired. |
| `POLICY_INVALID` | The policy document is invalid. |
| `POLICY_NAME_TAKEN` | Policy name taken. |
| `POLICY_NOT_FOUND` | Policy not found. |
| `ROLE_HAS_MEMBERS` | The role still has members; move them first. |
| `ROLE_NAME_TAKEN` | Role name taken. |
| `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` | Role not found. |
| `ROLE_SYSTEM_IMMUTABLE` | System roles (owner, admin, member) cannot be changed or deleted. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVATED` | The product is not activated for this workspace. |
| `SERVICE_UNKNOWN` | No product with this name. |
| `SOLE_OWNER` | The workspace's only owner cannot leave or be removed; transfer ownership first. |
| `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS` | Too many attempts; wait before trying again. |
| `WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED` | This route needs a workspace API key. |
